fact: As of 11 March 2025 the World Bank states that Mauritania's EMIS, renamed SIRAGE, was deployed through the World Bank-financed Basic Education Sector Support Project, that the sector plan PNDSE III (adopted March 2024) provides for 'operationalizing the existing education management information system (SIRAGE)', and that the proposed IQRAA programme would operationalise it for real-time collection of student enrolment, teacher deployment, school infrastructure and learning outcomes.
title: Program Information Document (PID): Mauritania Improving Education Quality, Results, and Access for All Program (IQRAA) (P509243)
